description:
Problem
WhatsApp group media sent without mentioning the receiving account is acknowledged but absent from canonical history. A later agent request therefore has no persisted attachment handle to pass to download_document.

Confirmed investigation
- deps/jido_chat_whatsapp/lib/jido_chat_whatsapp/adapter.ex normalize_media_references/2 intentionally seals media references and clears incoming.raw.
- lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/incoming/whatsapp.ex normalize/3 requires raw.channel_jid to match the room.
- Empty raw causes :unverified_communication_facts; the shared normalizer returns empty facts.
- JidoChatBridge sends unmentioned group media through capture_unaddressed_message and CommunicationBridge.receive_message.
- Engine API receive_incoming_message returns {:ok, :received} for :unsupported_history_kind without canonical persistence.
- download_document requires a materialization_handle; it cannot discover the omitted upload independently.
An isolated in-memory execution confirmed that identical group metadata succeeds with raw transport facts and fails with empty raw. No live production reproduction was performed.

Scope
Implement the correction in ZAQ. Consume and validate trusted normalized adapter fields for WhatsApp conversation identity instead of depending on raw provider payloads. The adapter already preserves channel_meta, external_room_id, author and timestamp. Preserve fail-closed handling of missing or contradictory evidence and keep private media internals out of canonical metadata. No jido_chat_whatsapp change is expected or planned.

Acceptance criteria
1. Adapter-normalized WhatsApp media with raw: %{} and valid normalized evidence yields the correct conversation type, source scope, sender membership and timestamp.
2. Unmentioned group media persists its canonical message and attachment source metadata without triggering an agent reply.
3. A later authorized request in the same conversation receives a hydrated attachment handle and can materialize it through the existing download_document flow.
4. Cover captionless media, media with captions, mentioned media, ordinary text, and direct-message normalization.
5. Missing/mismatched provider or room evidence remains rejected; self-message and history-sync guards remain intact.
6. Existing author authorization, connector scoping and private-media sanitization remain intact.
7. Regression coverage exercises actual adapter-normalized media through the ZAQ boundary, rather than fixtures that retain raw fields removed by the adapter.

Action reuse assessment
Reuse existing incoming normalization, receive_incoming_message, HistoryIngress.capture, attachment hydration, and download_document/materialization operations. This is a local normalization contract correction; no new Action, agent tool, provider fetch path, or automatic download is proposed.

Implementation and validation
Read applicable repository workflow, Channels service, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Add focused normalization and passive-history regression coverage, plus later authorized materialization coverage. Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test behavior. Follow required issue-level validation and final validation lifecycle. Treat investigation evidence as a code-level diagnosis; verify the complete path during implementation.

Authorization
This epic records the requested fix only. Creating it does not authorize implementation, dependency changes, commits, pushes or merging.

comments.text: Implementation refinement requested by user: shared sanitized-message normalization contract, no WhatsApp conditional in shared normalization/history/materialization. Shared Incoming validates empty raw plus nonempty media, matching configured provider/channel metadata, matching top-level room/chat type and sender/author identifiers. Optional provider integration callback validates native room/type semantics; existing raw validators remain authoritative for nonempty raw. Implement callback for WhatsApp and Telegram to demonstrate reuse; no dependency changes. Sanitized normalized facts are trusted internal adapter output, not authentication of arbitrary envelopes. Preserve sender grant checks and source scopes. Documentation will distinguish this explicit sanitized-media contract from inference based on defaults. Action reuse: extend existing IncomingNormalization and Incoming normalization only; reuse passive receive, HistoryIngress, hydrate and download operations. E2E not needed: backend normalization bug with boundary integration coverage and no UI change. No existing test assertions will be changed.

Boundary model: Incoming and IncomingNormalization own stateless interpretation of trusted adapter facts; native integrations classify room/type, with source_scope preserved. CommunicationBridge only routes canonical messages. Engine owns persistence, access, grants and execution admission; Materialization owns signed source-author redemption. No new persistent/runtime state or operation was introduced. The dependency chain is zaq-scg.1 -> zaq-scg.2 (verified via both blocks/blocked_by before implementation). Focused tests prove the adapter-to-history path; production live ingress was not exercised. Final precommit is now logged with a 900-second subprocess deadline after the host RPC disconnected at 300 seconds during the first run.

Implementation tasks zaq-scg.1 and zaq-scg.2 are complete and validated. Generic shared sanitized-media normalization is implemented with optional native classification callbacks (WhatsApp and Telegram); Engine/history/materialization operations are reused. Final mix q and mix precommit pass. Working-tree implementation is ready for human review. Epic remains in progress pending review and any subsequent coverage/PR/merge lifecycle; no commit, push or merge was performed.

title: Fix WhatsApp media history capture without bot mentions
